title: JM-041 / RADIO TRANSCRIPT RECONSTRUCTION
provenance: Archive-supplied working transcript, divided into six fragments. No original audio is attached in this build. Speaker labels identify channels, not authenticated individuals.
report: WORKING MISSION SUMMARY: The transport followed the dispatch plan until radio contact was lost. No useful further instructions were recorded in this summary.

clips.label: FRAGMENT A
clips.speaker: TRANSPORT
clips.text: Handover postponed, acknowledged. We have an equipment warning. Request immediate assistance.

clips.label: FRAGMENT B
clips.speaker: CONTROL CHANNEL / VOICE UNVERIFIED
clips.text: Transport, disregard the scheduled route. Use the alternate approach.

clips.label: FRAGMENT C
clips.speaker: TRANSPORT
clips.text: Control, transport airborne. Confirm the scheduled route.

clips.label: FRAGMENT E
clips.speaker: TRANSPORT
clips.text: Alternate approach acknowledged. Request confirmation of the cargo handover point.

clips.label: FRAGMENT F
clips.speaker: CONTROL CHANNEL / VOICE UNVERIFIED
clips.text: Cargo handover is postponed. Hold for further instructions.

conclusions.label: INSTRUCTIONS CHANGED
conclusions.explanation: The transcript includes a route change and postponed handover, which the working summary omits.

conclusions.label: SUMMARY IS COMPLETE
conclusions.explanation: Compare the alternate-approach instruction and postponed handover with the summary's claim.

conclusions.label: SPEAKER IDENTIFIED
conclusions.explanation: A channel label and transcript do not authenticate the individual speaking.

success: The reconstructed transcript contains a route change and postponed cargo handover absent from the working summary. It does not authenticate the speaker, identify a saboteur or locate John. Compare the primary archive material with Alex's retained copy after mission twelve.

messages.complete: Radio transcript reconstructed. Next: mission twelve, then compare the archive material with Alex's retained copy.
messages.unfinished: Your radio reconstruction is saved. You can return to it later.
